title: What a Traveller's Redemption Record Releases on an Air Ticket Fare Brands Booking
content:
A traveller who has redeemed points in the Wanderlane Traveller Club before, and whose Air Ticket Fare Brands booking has not yet been drawn on, releases a different share of the figure than one who has not. Two readings decide it: the points redemptions the membership shows over the last 12 months, and whether a redemption line yet stands on the booking.

## 1. The release-record share

1.1 Where the traveller's membership shows at least 1 points redemption over the last 12 months and no redemption line yet stands on the booking, the whole of the figure is carried forward: a share of 1.

1.2 Where the membership shows no points redemption over the last 12 months and no redemption line yet stands on the booking, the cautious release share of it is carried forward: 0.96, being 96 percent.

1.3 In every other case no such treatment applies to the share.

## 2. The two readings

The redemption count is of points redemptions standing in the membership's ledger inside the last 12 months. The booking test counts the redemption lines already standing on the air booking; "no redemption line yet stands" means there is none.

It follows that a booking already carrying a redemption line falls outside both of the first two conditions, whatever the membership shows.

## 3. Truth table

| Points redemptions in the membership over the last 12 months | A redemption line stands on the booking | Share carried forward |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 or more | no | 1 |
| none | no | 0.96 |
| 1 or more | yes | no such treatment |
| none | yes | no such treatment |

## 4. Hypothetical readings

A membership showing 2 points redemptions inside the window, on a booking with no redemption line standing on it, carries the whole of the figure forward.

The same membership on a booking that already carries 1 redemption line falls to the third row, and no such treatment applies.

A membership showing no redemption at all inside the window, on a booking with no redemption line standing on it, carries 96 percent of the figure forward.
